description: Spring Boot CoffeeShop web application with intentionally vulnerable request handling, persistence, file upload, rendering, and encryption code.

vulnerabilities.description: Untrusted HTTP input flows into YAML deserialization, allowing attacker-controlled object data (Snyk: java/Deserialization, CWE-502).
Spring Security CSRF protection is disabled, allowing forged state-changing requests (Snyk: java/DisablesCSRFProtection, CWE-352).
The encryption service uses the broken DES algorithm for key generation (Snyk: java/InsecureCipher, CWE-327).
The encryption service uses insecure DES/ECB/PKCS5Padding for cipher operations (Snyk: java/InsecureCipher, CWE-327).
An HTTP-controlled upload path flows into file writing without sufficient containment validation (Snyk: java/PT, CWE-23).
An HTTP parameter flows into a native SQL query without parameterization (Snyk: java/Sqli, CWE-89).
An HTTP parameter is rendered into an HTML response without adequate output encoding (Snyk: java/XSS, CWE-79).
A second HTTP-controlled product value is rendered into an HTML response without adequate output encoding (Snyk: java/XSS, CWE-79).
